headers.subject: Annual Policy Review – Acknowledgement Needed by Friday

body_text:
Hi Site Ops Team,
The updated Nebulon Site Conduct Policy for 2025 is ready for review. Please read the attached PDF and acknowledge in the compliance tracker by Friday EOD so we can close out the annual requirement.
If you have questions on the changes (Section 4: visitor access; Section 7: reporting), reply to this thread, and we’ll route them to Legal.
Thanks,
Compliance Operations
Attachment: Nebulon_Site_Conduct_Policy_2025.pdf
